CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select exists (
        select 1
        from public.users
        where user_id = (select auth.uid())
          and lower(coalesce(role, '')) = 'admin'
    );
$function$
